result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. One minor issue: the delivery address text appears to run into the dropdown chevron, slightly clipping the end of the street name.

issues.description: The top delivery address line renders 'Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn' with the final 'i' appearing clipped or overlapped by the dropdown chevron, making the street name look truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container's width or padding so the full address fits without colliding with the chevron, and ensure the chevron is properly aligned.
